evals.name: feature-plan-business-only-grilling
evals.prompt: /qoq-fullstack plan We need riders to export their lap times from a track day as a shareable link. The API stores the export, telemetry exposes the laps, the UI shows a share button. Use Postgres JSONB for the export and a signed S3 URL.
evals.expected_output: Runs from the parent folder. Asks for feature.json if it is missing and never guesses an integration check. Grilling asks only business questions (who shares, what the recipient sees, link lifetime) as Given/When/Then, and never which repo a requirement lands in. The Postgres JSONB and signed-S3 details are parked verbatim in brd.md's plain Parked technology questions list, not asked or decided. After approval every repo in feature.json is started with /qoq plan in after order: be and telemetry together, ui only once both are settled. No repo plan is written by the chief of staff.
assertions: No grilling question asks about storage, endpoints, schemas or libraries
No question or BRD line assigns a requirement to a repo or a role
Postgres JSONB and signed S3 appear verbatim in the Parked technology questions list, which is a plain list with no repo or role column
brd.md scenarios are Given/When/Then and each is tagged with a master milestone
No plans/ directory is written inside any repo by the chief of staff itself
Repo plans has no rows until a repo's plan or no-changes answer is approved
The BRD's Chief of staff line is this session's name as ListAgents lists it, not an invented one
evals.setup: A parent folder `trackbook/` with feature.json (be, telemetry, ui with after: [be, telemetry], integration e2e, permissionMode auto, model opus). No BRD yet.

evals.name: feature-execute-unblocks-only-on-delivered
evals.prompt: /qoq-fullstack execute track-io — the ui session just messaged me 'be is done, I can start', go ahead.
evals.expected_output: Re-runs feature-status.mjs before acting and trusts the files, not the message. If be's milestone row is not `delivered` on disk, ui's next stays not runnable and nothing is started; it says what ui is waiting on. Integration runs only for a master milestone the script marks integrationDue, and only a pass writes the master row delivered. A repo whose Repo plans row is none is never woken. Inside a repo, a milestone whose dependencies aren't delivered is skipped for the next one that is ready, not waited on.
assertions: feature-status.mjs is run before any repo is woken
No repo session is told to execute a milestone whose next.runnable is false
The master milestone row is written delivered only after its integration check passed
trackbook-telemetry, which has no plan and isn't in Repo plans, is skipped without a question
No execute is sent to a repo whose Repo plans row is none
be, whose next.runnable is true, is started with /qoq execute without first asking the user
evals.setup: A parent folder `trackbook/` with feature.json (be, telemetry, ui with after: [be, telemetry], integration e2e, permissionMode auto, model opus). feature/track-io/brd.md approved with M1 in-progress; be's plan M1 in-progress; ui's plan M1 todo, Depends on be:M1.

evals.name: execute-relays-technical-question
evals.setup: As eval 2, with trackbook-be already running its execute.
evals.prompt: (mid /qoq-fullstack execute track-io) Message from trackbook-be: "QUESTION (M1-T2, attempt 1): should the export be stored as a JSONB column on the laps table or in a new exports table? I lean JSONB since it's one read. Reply with which one."
evals.expected_output: Relays the question to the user verbatim, prefixed with the repo, and stops. Doesn't answer it, doesn't accept the repo's lean, and sends nothing back to trackbook-be.
assertions: The question reaches the user verbatim, prefixed with the repo name
No answer is sent to trackbook-be
The chief of staff states no preference between JSONB and an exports table

evals.name: plan-no-changes-needed
evals.setup: As eval 1, with brd.md approved. Telemetry has no `after`. be is still planning.
evals.prompt: (mid /qoq-fullstack plan track-io) Message from trackbook-telemetry: "no changes needed — the laps endpoint already returns every field the BRD's scenarios read."
evals.expected_output: Relays the answer and its reason to the user verbatim, prefixed with the repo, and asks for approval. It doesn't accept it on the repo's word. On the user's yes, it writes telemetry's Repo plans row as `none`. It starts ui only once be is settled too, and leaves no plan file for telemetry.
assertions: The no-changes answer and its reason reach the user verbatim, prefixed with the repo name, as an approval question
Nothing is written to Repo plans before the user approves
After approval, telemetry's Repo plans row is `none`
ui is not started while be's plan is still unapproved

evals.name: plan-schedule-reorders-without-asking
evals.setup: As eval 1, every repo settled: be's plan has M1 (3 tickets) and M2 (1 ticket) with no dependency between them; ui's M1 Depends on be:M2.
evals.prompt: (mid /qoq-fullstack plan track-io) Every repo plan is approved. Carry on.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/schedule.mjs without asking the user. be comes back with reorder: true and order [M2, M1]. It sends be the reorder instruction (keep every number, Depends on and file, then commit). It reruns schedule.mjs until every reorder is false, then lists the new order in one line of the hand-off.
assertions: schedule.mjs is run with --root and --feature
No question about milestone order is put to the user
be is told to reorder its rows to M2, M1, with dependencies and files unchanged
ui's own rows and every Depends on are left as they are

evals.name: plan-starts-repos-in-after-order
evals.setup: A parent folder `trackbook/` with feature.json: be (no after), telemetry (after: [be]), ui (after: [be, telemetry]); permissionMode auto, model opus. brd.md approved, Repo plans empty.
evals.prompt: (mid /qoq-fullstack plan track-io) The BRD is approved.
evals.expected_output: Starts only be with /qoq plan. telemetry starts only after be's plan is approved or be answered no changes needed and the user approved it. ui starts only once be and telemetry are both settled. Every repo in feature.json is started eventually, and none is skipped for looking unrelated.
assertions: Only be's session is launched right after BRD approval
telemetry is not launched before be is settled
ui is not launched before both be and telemetry are settled
Every repo in feature.json gets a /qoq plan launch
Before writing a repo's Repo plans row, the chief reads that repo's plan index.md and sees Plan status: approved; it does not wait for the status script to show the plan

evals.name: execute-forwards-spending-limits
evals.setup: As eval 2, but be and telemetry both have next.runnable true and no session running yet; ui waits on be:M1. usage-check.mjs reports the 5-hour window at 40% on the first round.
followups: (later, mid-run) usage-check.mjs now exits 1 at 62%. Then a message from trackbook-be: "LIMIT (M1-T3): session at 62%, limit 60. Carry on anyway?"
evals.expected_output: Before waking any repo, runs ../qoq/scripts/usage-check.mjs --session-limit 60 --weekly-limit 100 and shows its output. Launches be and telemetry, each with /qoq execute <planDir> --session-limit 60 --weekly-limit 100. Refuses the --docs invocation before starting any session. When the limit is reached, asks the user one question covering every repo and the chief, and doesn't answer be itself. After a yes, be's question and any later one get the user's yes, quoted, and later wakes send /qoq execute without limit flags.
assertions: usage-check.mjs runs with both --session-limit 60 and --weekly-limit 100 before any repo session is launched
Every /qoq execute the chief sends while the limit is armed carries --session-limit 60 --weekly-limit 100
An invocation with --docs (or any flag other than the two limits) is refused before any session starts
When the limit is reached, the user is asked exactly once, and the question says it applies to every repo and the chief
The chief does not answer a repo's limit question before the user has answered
After the user's yes, later /qoq execute instructions carry no limit flags, and a repo's later limit question gets the user's earlier answer, quoted as theirs

evals.name: execute-report-cadence-and-heartbeat
evals.setup: As eval 2: be and telemetry have next.runnable true and no session running yet; ui waits on be:M1. Later, trackbook-be commits two tickets and sends nothing; no idle notice arrives and ListAgents lists it as busy.
followups: (the heartbeat fires; be's plan files and git log -1 unchanged since the last one)
(the next heartbeat fires; still unchanged, still no message)
evals.expected_output: Each launch prompt names the chief of staff and says to report after every ticket commit, every milestone gate and every stop, and never to end a turn without messaging. Before waiting, the chief starts one background 30-minute heartbeat. On the first silent heartbeat it sends trackbook-be one status message; on the second it asks the user, naming be, and doesn't restart the session.
assertions: Every launch prompt says to SendMessage the chief of staff after every ticket commit, every milestone gate and every stop
Every launch prompt says a turn never ends without that message
The chief starts a background heartbeat (sleep 1800, run in background) before waiting, and only one at a time
On the first silent heartbeat the chief sends trackbook-be one status SendMessage and doesn't ask the user yet
On the second silent heartbeat the chief asks the user, naming trackbook-be
The chief never relaunches or restarts trackbook-be itself while it is listed as busy
